en.name: AGStudio
en.subtitle: Prompt to picture
en.short_description: Describe an image, pick a style and a size, and keep what you make in a gallery.
en.description:
AGStudio turns a written prompt into an image.

MAKE SOMETHING
Type what you want. Choose a style — photorealistic, cinematic, anime, cyberpunk, fantasy, abstract, minimal, or neon — and a resolution. AGStudio checks the prompt before sending it.

WHERE IMAGES COME FROM
Your prompt is sent to Pollinations.ai, a free public AI image service, which draws the image. Images are 512×512 or 768×768 and carry a small Pollinations logo. The free service limits how often you can generate; if it is busy, wait a minute and try again.

KEEP IT
Everything you generate lands in a gallery on your device. Open any result full size, save it to your photo library, or share it.

NO ACCOUNT
AGStudio does not ask you to register. Your history is on your phone.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
AGStudio turns a written prompt into an image.

Intended audience:
Prompt to picture

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Pollinations.ai (https://image.pollinations.ai), a free public text-to-image service that needs no account or key. The prompt text is sent to it and the image it returns is saved on the device. Requests carry safe=true (Pollinations' content filter) and private=true (kept out of its public feed). It refuses requests made too close together (HTTP 402); the app shows that as an error and makes nothing up in its place. Please allow about a minute between test generations.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. Images are generated by Pollinations.ai from the user's own prompt; the app ships no third-party artwork. Copy is the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
